Desc.SourceString: 呜哇，烫烫烫——但是好好吃！
Desc.LocalizedString: Ooow, it's ho-ho-hot! But it's so good!

Desc.SourceString: 好香啊！不愧是卜多力的招牌！
Desc.LocalizedString: That tasty smell! No wonder it's the house special of Budoriya!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，你也点了这个？看来我们的口味很一致嘛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, you ordered this too? We got similar tastes!

Desc.SourceString: 这个超好吃的，要不要尝尝？
Desc.LocalizedString: This is suuuper good. Wanna try?

Desc.SourceString: 别发呆了，可可，再不吃菜就凉了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, the dish will get cold if you keep staring!

Desc.SourceString: 唔，我是不是吃的有点多了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Umm, did I eat too much?

Desc.SourceString: 同样的东西，和可可一起吃好像更香了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, you make food taste so much better!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，干杯——！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, cheers!

Desc.SourceString: 呼啊，好饱好饱——多谢款待，可可，我们下次再来吃，我请你！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wah, I'm so full! Thanks, Coco. I'll buy you a meal the next time!

Desc.SourceString: 摩天轮转一圈要多久呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: How long does it take for the Ferris wheel to spin once?

Desc.SourceString: 要是带点零食上来就好了！
Desc.LocalizedString: If only we brought some snacks with us!

Desc.SourceString: 啦啦啦~
Desc.LocalizedString: (Hums to herserlf)

Desc.SourceString: 换个角度看海特洛，还挺新奇的嘛！
Desc.LocalizedString: Hethereau is different from this angle. Interesting!

Desc.SourceString: 快看，窗外的云彩很漂亮哦！唔，想吃棉花糖了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Look! The clouds has pretty colors. Ow, I want cotton candy now…

Desc.SourceString: 好美的风景！可可，我们来合张影吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: So beautiful! Coco, let's take a pic together!

Desc.SourceString: 完全没有坐够嘛！可可，下次还要一起玩，就这么说好啦！
Desc.LocalizedString: That wasn't nearly enough! Coco, let's come play together. It's a deal!

Desc.SourceString: 这段剧情真不错！可可也这么觉得吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: This plot is fire! Coco, do you think so too?

Desc.SourceString: 听说片尾还有彩蛋呢，待会儿可别急着走！
Desc.LocalizedString: I heard there's an Easter Egg at the end. Don't leave too fast!

Desc.SourceString: 可可，再走神就要错过精彩片段了！
Desc.LocalizedString: Coco, you're about to miss a great scene!

Desc.SourceString: 呼啊，看的好过瘾！之后上映新影片的时候再来一起看吧！
Desc.LocalizedString: Uwu, that was fun! Let's come again when there's a new movie!

Desc.SourceString: 吃我一拳！小菜一碟……欸欸等一下，空大了！？
Desc.LocalizedString: Eat this! Piece of cake… Oh wait, I missed!?

Desc.SourceString: 左边！右边！左边！右边！赢！
Desc.LocalizedString: Left! Right! Left Right! I win!

Desc.SourceString: 看不起谁呢？！柯林斯家族永不言败！
Desc.LocalizedString: Who do you think I am? The Coluccis never give up!

Desc.SourceString: 要切磋一下吗？我可不会手下留情！
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you want to play with me? I won't go easy on you!

Desc.SourceString: 唉，有言道胜败乃兵家常事。更何况，输给我你也不算丢人。下次我让着你点，放心~
Desc.LocalizedString: Ah, win some lose some. Besides, losing to me is nothing to be ashamed of. I'll go easy on you next time, I promise.

Desc.SourceString: 不行不行，这把不算。主要是今天没吃饱，输出力度不够！
Desc.LocalizedString: No, no, that doesn't count. I didn't eat enough today. I couldn't pack my punch!

Desc.SourceString: 今天也算是玩了个爽！强者相伴，不虚此行~鉴定师，我们下次再战！
Desc.LocalizedString: Well, I had a lot of fun. It was nice having someone as strong as you. Let's fight again!

Desc.SourceString: 我脸上有东西吗……不会是什么虫子？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Is there something on my face…? Is it a bug?

Desc.SourceString: 流星雨划过的时候，记得许愿噢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Remember to make a wish when you see a meteor.

Desc.SourceString: 像这样一起荡着秋千，听听虫鸣……好开心。
Desc.LocalizedString: Swinging together like this, listening to the crickets… this is nice.

Desc.SourceString: 果然和鉴定师待在一起，总能看到特别漂亮的风景~嘿嘿。
Desc.LocalizedString: Hehe, I knew I'd see great stuff if I'm with you.

Desc.SourceString: 啦~哒啦~🎵
Desc.LocalizedString: La~da~la~🎵

Desc.SourceString: 离天空最近的点在哪呢……
Desc.LocalizedString: When is it closest to the sky…?

Desc.SourceString: 里面暖呼呼的……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's warm inside…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，你会不会恐高？别担心，有我在！
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, are you afraid of heights? Don't worry, I'm here!

Desc.SourceString: 摩天轮和冰淇淋最适配了，一会儿去买一个~？
Desc.LocalizedString: Ice cream is great for Ferris wheels! Let's buy some soon?

Desc.SourceString: 绝佳观赏点！一起合影怎么样？
Desc.LocalizedString: Perfect spot! Let's take a pic together!

Desc.SourceString: 突然想到了一件很好的事……暂时保密！下次坐摩天轮的时候告诉你！
Desc.LocalizedString: I just had a great idea… I'll keep it a secret for now. I'll tell you the next time we come here!

Desc.SourceString: 你也觉得这个主角很逊吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You think this MC sucks too?

Desc.SourceString: 看到刚刚那幕了吗？！燃爆了！！
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you see that? That was insane!

Desc.SourceString: 感觉……是不是缺了爆米花和可乐？
Desc.LocalizedString: Are we… missing popcorn and soda?

Desc.SourceString: 这部也还不赖嘛！下次我们再选什么题材看看呢……？
Desc.LocalizedString: That movie wasn't so bad! What should we watch next…?

Desc.SourceString: 若是执行任务，这里会是个不错的观察点。
Desc.LocalizedString: This is a good observation spot for a mission.

Desc.SourceString: 风声都被隔绝在外了~
Desc.LocalizedString: There's no wind inside!

Desc.SourceString: 身处高处，向来更容易判断局势。
Desc.LocalizedString: High spots are great for making decisions.

Desc.SourceString: 看来今天的风景，并不只是窗外这一片。
Desc.LocalizedString: Seems like there's more to see that what's outside of the window.

Desc.SourceString: 你看得如此认真，是发现了什么吗？
Desc.LocalizedString: You staring so intently. Did you find something?

Desc.SourceString: 我在想接下来的行程……鉴定师，你呢，你想去哪里？
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I'm thinking… Where do you want to go next?

Desc.SourceString: 希望下次还有机会和你一同乘坐摩天轮，鉴定师~
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I hope I can come here with you for the Ferris wheel again!

Desc.SourceString: 你刚才也注意到了吗？这段内容对观众，未免有些小小的误导~
Desc.LocalizedString: Did you notice that too? I think that could mislead the audience a bit.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么？已经有结论了？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hmm? You know what's happening next?

Desc.SourceString: 或许这种时候，更需要几分专注。
Desc.LocalizedString: Maybe it's time to focus a little.

Desc.SourceString: 下次如果有合适的电影，可别忘了叫上我，鉴定师。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, if there's a good movie, don't forget to let me know.

Desc.SourceString: 很平稳呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: It's steady.

Desc.SourceString: 如果一只鸟不小心撞过来……
Desc.LocalizedString: If a bird flew over here…

Desc.SourceString: 一个浪漫的密闭空间，呵呵~
Desc.LocalizedString: A romantic, confined space. Heh…

Desc.SourceString: 我在看风景……你在看谁~？
Desc.LocalizedString: I'm admiring what's outside… And you are?

Desc.SourceString: 摩天轮啊。这地方总是出现在情人约会的场所呢~
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, a Ferris wheel. It always becomes a popular dating site.

Desc.SourceString: 或许还能做些有意思的事情……♥
Desc.LocalizedString: Perhaps it's a good place to do something fun…♥

Desc.SourceString: 哎呀，一副意犹未尽的表情呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh my, you look like you want more.

Desc.SourceString: 是谁分心了~？
Desc.LocalizedString: Who's not focusing?

Desc.SourceString: 意思是……我比电影好看吗？♥
Desc.LocalizedString: Do you mean… I'm more interesting than the movie? ♥

Desc.SourceString: 昏暗的地方，总让人有种危险的暧昧感……你觉得呢？
Desc.LocalizedString: Dim places have a dangerous chemistry… don't they?

Desc.SourceString: 这么快就放映结束了……是因为和你在一起，时间过得特别快吗~？
Desc.LocalizedString: It ended that fast? Or was it because… time flies when I'm with you?

Desc.SourceString: 越来越高了……
Desc.LocalizedString: It's getting higher…

Desc.SourceString: 应该是……是安全的吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: This is… safe, right?

Desc.SourceString: 地上的灯像是星星……
Desc.LocalizedString: The lights on the ground look like stars…

Desc.SourceString: 没、没有很害怕，在你身边很安全。
Desc.LocalizedString: I-I'm not afraid. I feel safe around you.

Desc.SourceString: 虽然很、很高，但上面的风景很好呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Although we're h-high up, the view is great.

Desc.SourceString: 从高处看下去，会感觉到……很自由
Desc.LocalizedString: Looking down from here… I feel free…

Desc.SourceString: 重回地面了……下、下次还可以一起。
Desc.LocalizedString: And… we're back down. Let's d-do this again.

Desc.SourceString: 是要……聊聊后面的剧情的吗？但请、请不要剧透。
Desc.LocalizedString: You know wh-what's… happening next? P-Please don't tell me.

Desc.SourceString: 我也很喜欢刚刚那个情节。
Desc.LocalizedString: I liked that scene a lot.

Desc.SourceString: 怎、怎么了吗？难道我、我刚刚叫出声了？！
Desc.LocalizedString: Wh-What? Did I let out a s-squeak?

Desc.SourceString: 结束了吗？真想再看一场啊……
Desc.LocalizedString: That's it? I want to watch another one…

Desc.SourceString: 世上没有完全相同的两片风景……每分每秒都在变。
Desc.LocalizedString: There are no two movies that are the same… Things change every second.

Desc.SourceString: 我喜欢这旋转的速度，优哉游哉、稳步向前。
Desc.LocalizedString: I like this speed. It's easy and unhurried, spinning steadily.

Desc.SourceString: 在这个角度能看着伊波恩么？唉~地段……地段。
Desc.LocalizedString: Can we see Eibon from here? (Sigh) Locations, locations.

Desc.SourceString: 这样悠闲的时光还真是不赖。
Desc.LocalizedString: Peaceful moments like these are rather nice.

Desc.SourceString: 我的招财宝，你有放松一些了么？
Desc.LocalizedString: My Precious, have you relaxed a bit?

Desc.SourceString: 有没有觉得，摩天轮就像这座城市里最大的时钟？
Desc.LocalizedString: Don't you think the Ferris wheel is the largest clock in the city?

Desc.SourceString: 真舒心哪~我都有些困了。
Desc.LocalizedString: That was relaxing. I'm almost sleepy.

Desc.SourceString: 怎么？你不是想说中途退场吧？
Desc.LocalizedString: Hey, you're not leaving, are you?

Desc.SourceString: 咱们花了钱的，就是不喜欢也得看完，明白了么？
Desc.LocalizedString: We spilled the Fons, so we're finishing the movie. Understood?

Desc.SourceString: 你想多看点细节？我倒是可以帮你调慢播放速度。
Desc.LocalizedString: You want to see more details? I can slow down the movie for you.

Desc.SourceString: 即使猜到了结局……好好见证到最后也是观众的素养呢。
Desc.LocalizedString: Even if you guessed the ending, a good audience should witness the movie till the end.

Desc.SourceString: 摩天轮，转得好慢。小房间，摇摇晃晃……
Desc.LocalizedString: Ferris wheel, so slow. Small room, shaking…

Desc.SourceString: 在下面看，摩天轮好像能够到云彩。坐到上面，发现天空还是好远……
Desc.LocalizedString: Looking from below, Ferris wheel, as tall as clouds. Sitting here, sky still far…

Desc.SourceString: 转动摩天轮的人，是谁？力气很大，安魂曲，很佩服……
Desc.LocalizedString: Who turns Ferris wheel? Very strong. Lacrimosa, impressed…

Desc.SourceString: 鉴定师，快来看。下面的人，比番茄籽还要小。
Desc.LocalizedString: Appraiser, look. People below, smaller than tomato seed.

Desc.SourceString: 那里，好像有冰淇淋车……下去之后，想买冰淇淋。
Desc.LocalizedString: There, ice cream cart… Want buy ice cream, when get down.

Desc.SourceString: 大楼的玻璃，都亮亮的。真好。管理局的玻璃不亮，安魂曲才会撞到……
Desc.LocalizedString: Those buildings, shiny glass. BAC glass, not shiny. Lacrimosa, bump into it…

Desc.SourceString: 安魂曲平时，只能自己飞。在高处和鉴定师一起，很新鲜。下次，还想一起坐摩天轮……
Desc.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa, flies alone. With Appraiser this high, is fun. Next time, Ferris wheel again…

Desc.SourceString: 电影院，好黑。安魂曲，困了……
Desc.LocalizedString: Theater, dark. Lacrimosa, sleepy…

Desc.SourceString: 怪兽，好帅。安魂曲，也想像那样。
Desc.LocalizedString: Monster, so cool. Lacrimosa, want be cool too.

Desc.SourceString: 唔，屏幕里的人在哭……安魂曲，想帮忙……
Desc.LocalizedString: Oh, person in screen, crying… Lacrimosa, want to help…

Desc.SourceString: 电影，真有趣。安魂曲，很开心。谢谢鉴定师，邀请安魂曲……
Desc.LocalizedString: Movie, so fun. Lacrimosa, happy. Thank you, Appraiser, for inviting…
